results.title: Sound issues since I upgraded to Windows 11 (Focusrite Interface) - Microsoft Q&A
results.content:
I have been having the same problem with Windows 11 since June of last year. SO frustrating. My main issues occur while streaming music like Spotify, then when I execute other processes like loading a script heavy web page, or opening other programs - the sound will pause and then be delayed, or it will skip and start crackling like CRAZY, with lots of distortion.

The only way I can fix it is to unplug the interface, and plug it back in. I do this probably 10 times a day because I'm a voice teacher and use my computer audio all the time.

The audio has no issues playing from my computer, or over 3.5 aux port. This is a USB issue with Windows 11. I think the power is occasionally lowered or is dropped for the USB ports for power management, and it wreaks havoc.
